description.vi: Quyền của Lead, trợ lý của bạn: đổi Soot, lịch, đội, phê duyệt, quyền dữ liệu và mức mô hình của Nest.
description.en: The Lead's authority: change this Nest's Soots, schedules, teams, approvals, data access and model tiers, with person approval for what is not the Lead's to decide alone.

tools.name: manage
tools.title: Đổi cài đặt Nest
tools.description: Read and change this Nest's settings as the Lead, the person's assistant: Soots, schedules, teams, projects (create, rename, which a team serves), the workspace ontology, flows (tests of a process) and workspace improvement, tool approvals, data access, model tiers, website clients, updates, token budgets, Soot improvement, who reaches which tables, memory and files (access), and who is paired to the Telegram/Discord bots (status, revoke). Connecting a bot is not here: that is the person's, in Kênh chat. Read first to get the revision. A change only the person may approve (delete, a grant you do not hold yourself, relaxing an approval, a customer-facing Soot) is refused with the reason; send that same input to manage_gated.

action.description: read (the default) lists Soots, schedules, teams, gated tools and model tiers with the revision to pass back; id reads one Soot with its Markdown. updates.status, usage.read, channel.status and templates.list only read. undo reverses an earlier change named by undo. ontology.read and flow.list, flow.result, improve.status, improve.history only read. improve.* with scope "workspace" acts on the whole workspace; without scope it acts on the Soot in id.

request_id.description: A fresh id for each change. Reuse it only to retry the same input after a lost reply, or to send a change refused for approval to manage_gated; after any other refusal use a new id.

revision.description: The revision from your last read. If settings changed since, the change is refused: read again and redo it.

id.description: The Soot, schedule, team, tool, tier or website client the change is about; for flow.save and flow.delete "<process>/<name>"; for flow.result a run id or "latest"; for improve.revert (scope workspace) the receipt id. Empty with soot.save creates a Soot.

changes.description: soot.save: only the fields to change; name, description, mascot, avatar, tier, packs (pack refs such as "office" or "data-pool:read"), soul, mission. A new Soot needs name, mission and soul.

schedule.description: schedule.save: {soot, name, text, every, at, cron, timezone, group, paused}; every like 24h, at like 08:00, or cron like 0 9 * * 1-5 (Thứ 2–6 lúc 09:00) instead of every.

approval.description: approval.policy for tool id: operator waits for the person, auto runs alone, default follows its Pack.

data_pool.description: soot.data_pool: the host's shared data pool on or off for Soot id.

host_pack.description: soot.host_packs: answer a source Soot's request for a host pack; ref is the pack ("browser-use" or "data-pool:read").

pack_grant.description: pack.grant: grant (true) or withdraw (false) what an installed pack declares it needs from this host — its credentials, the workspace folder, env variables. Granting always asks the person.

group.description: group.create: {template, name, title, profile, brief, binding_files}; template from templates.list, name the team's short id, title what the person calls it, profile one of the template's profiles, brief the answers by input id.

team.description: group.policy.create or save: {name, description, entries, members}; members maps Soot ids to {}.

model.description: tier.save: the tier as read, with only what you mean to change. tier.delete takes only id.

client.description: client.create or client.save: {soots, origins, limits, widget}; only what changes. Never a key.

improve.description: soot.improve: {schedule: {every, at, budget, paused}}; a null schedule switches improvement off.

kind.description: updates.apply: the kind of the update item, as updates.status names it; its id goes in id.

update_policy.description: updates.policy: only the kinds that change; auto applies by itself, manual waits for the person.

budget.description: budget.save: {daily_tokens, max_run_tokens} for Soot id; only what changes.

channel.description: channel.unpair: {binding, pairing} exactly as channel.status lists them. Never a bot token.

subject.description: soot:<id> or team:<id>: who gets it.

scope.description: workspace, team:<id> or soot:<id>: the level it reaches.

kinds.description: access.grant: the whole list for this subject and level; it replaces what they had there.

access.description: access.grant or access.revoke: who reaches the tables (data), memory and files of a level. read returns the current grants under access.

undo.description: With action undo: the request_id of the change to reverse.

company_project.description: company.project.save: {id, name}. A new id (lowercase, -) creates the project; an existing id renames it. Deleting a project is the person's, in Nest.

group_projects.description: group.projects: {group, projects}. The project ids a team serves; an empty list means all projects.

scope.description: improve.*: "workspace" improves the whole workspace (ontology, teams, budgets) from its flows; omit for one Soot named by id.

improve_budget.description: improve.run, scope workspace: weighted-token budget; leave it out for the default. Above 500000 is the person's: send to manage_gated.

ontology.description: ontology.save: the whole ontology/v1 document ({version, about?, terms?, teams?, entities, relations, processes}). Removing a gates entry is held for the person.

flow.description: flow.save: a flow document {process?, world?, cases[]}; id is "<process>/<name>".

flow_run.description: flow.run: pick flows by ids, a process or a tag; attempts is how many fresh worlds each runs in. Returns a run id for flow.result.

draft.description: improve.drafts.accept: the draft id for Soot id; only drafts whose source is flow:<id>.

tools.name: manage_gated
tools.title: Đổi cài đặt quan trọng của Nest
tools.description: The same change as manage, held for the person's approval in Cần bạn with a preview of exactly what changes. Use it when manage said the change needs approval, or when you already know it is one only the person approves (the list in nest-manage): then skip manage and send it here.
